description: CPU-only suite: FreeCAD with no GPU at all. Three independent paths -- (1) headless FreeCADCmd with no GUI/GL/Vulkan context, (2) the fork's Vulkan viewport on a software Vulkan device (Mesa lavapipe, VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_CPU) over xcb/XWayland, (3) native Wayland with software OpenGL (Mesa llvmpipe). The software drivers are discovered by the cpu-xcb / cpu-gl harness profiles from FC_CPU_ICD / FC_CPU_MESA_LIB or conventional locations; a case fails loudly if no software device came up (rather than silently using the GPU). Software Vulkan has no Wayland WSI in Mesa's lavapipe builds, so case (2) uses xcb; case (3) covers native Wayland via llvmpipe.
